summary.en: DingTalk deliveries now avoid robot rate limits and recover safely when throttled
summary.zh-CN: 钉钉推送现可主动避开机器人频率限制，并在触发限流后安全恢复

text.en: DingTalk channels now share a persistent sending window by robot token, limiting delivery to one message every four seconds across channels, processes, and restarts.
text.zh-CN: 钉钉渠道现按机器人 Token 共享持久化发送窗口，在不同渠道、进程和服务重启之间统一限制为每四秒发送一条消息。

text.en: Official DingTalk error code 410100 now starts a ten-minute cooldown before retrying, while system-busy responses use bounded exponential backoff and permanent business errors stop retrying.
text.zh-CN: 收到钉钉官方错误码 410100 后会冷却十分钟再重试；系统繁忙响应改用有上限的指数退避，永久性业务错误则停止重试。

text.en: Delivery records and event details now show localized throttle states, the next attempt time, and the provider error code without exposing robot credentials or raw downstream responses.
text.zh-CN: 推送记录与消息详情现会显示双语限流状态、下次尝试时间和渠道错误码，同时不会暴露机器人凭据或下游原始响应。

en: Deploy the immutable beta-v0.11.0 image and restart the container.
The notification_rate_limits table and new delivery fields are created automatically at startup; no manual configuration change is required.
zh-CN: 部署不可变镜像 beta-v0.11.0 并重启容器。
启动时会自动创建 notification_rate_limits 表及新的推送记录字段，无需手动修改配置。
